 A file photo dated Aug 25, 2016 shows a temple in Sai Noi district in Ayutthaya province. Many districts in low-lying communities in Ayutthaya, Ang Thong and Suphan Buri have been designated as flood retention zone to regulate flood water from hitting downstream provinces. Soothorn Pongpao 
 Every flood in Bangkok comes with a second flood that is harder to see. It is the argument about where the water goes.
